note:
ANOTHER FLOOR BANKED AGAINST A TREE NOBODY CAN REACH, AND THE SECOND ONE FOR THIS GATE.

22700 -> 22698, and none of the -2 is this change. Measured with the CI command,
`npx eslint . -f json` summed over `errorCount`, in a detached worktree at
/var/tmp with node_modules symlinked in:

  8b8a26297b0  (the commit that SET 22700)   22698
  HEAD         (ce40e827b21)                 22698
  HEAD + this change                         22698

So the floor never reproduced at its own commit -- it has been red at -2 since
the moment it was banked, and only three commits have landed since, two of them
touching tooling alone. That is the same failure this baseline`s previous note
opens with in capitals about ITS predecessor: a count taken from a working tree
that was never committed. Twice on one gate is a pattern, not an accident; the
measurement above is reproducible from any checkout of either commit.

The change measured against it -- `CharField.shouldTrim` becoming a prop the
field-registry descriptor sets, so `char_emojis` stops overriding the getter --
is eslint-neutral: the same 22698 before and after, on the same tree.
